fields.biography_uz: Allayev Dolli Hakimovich 1993-yilda Qarshi davlat universitetini Biologiya va kimyo fani o‘qituvchisi mutaxassisligi bo‘yicha tamomlagan. Biologiya va qishloq xo‘jaligi fanlari doktori, professor. Ko‘p yillar davomida universitetda kafedra mudiri, fakultet dekani, ilmiy laboratoriyalar rahbari hamda oliy ta’lim tizimida prorektorlik va ilmiy rahbarlik lavozimlarida samarali faoliyat yuritib kelmoqda.
fields.biography_en: Allayev Dolli Hakimovich graduated from Karshi State University in 1993 with a degree in Biology and Chemistry Teaching. He holds a DSc degree and Professor title, having served as department chair, dean, and university vice-rector.
fields.career_story_uz: Universitetdagi talabalik yillaridayoq murakkab muhandislik hisob-kitoblari va dasturlashga qiziqishi yuqori bo‘lgan. O‘qishni tamomlagach, ilmiy-tadqiqot institutlarida kichik ilmiy xodimlikdan boshlab, professorlik va ilmiy markaz rahbarligigacha bo‘lgan sharafli yo‘lni bosib o‘tgan.
fields.career_story_en: Starting his academic journey at KarSU, he developed a deep passion for computational engineering, rising from junior researcher to renowned professor and research director.

fields.biography_uz: Panjiyev Maqsud Aliqulovich 2003-yilda Qarshi davlat universitetini Matematika va informatika o‘qituvchisi mutaxassisligi bo‘yicha tamomlagan. Keyinchalik axborot-kommunikatsiya texnologiyalari yo‘nalishida tahsil olgan, pedagogika fanlari bo‘yicha falsafa doktori (PhD). Ta’lim tizimida o‘qituvchilikdan boshlab, tuman hokimi o‘rinbosari hamda viloyat maktabgacha va maktab ta’limi boshqarmasi boshlig‘i o‘rinbosari darajasigacha bo‘lgan mas’uliyatli boshqaruv yo‘lini bosib o‘tgan.
fields.biography_en: Panjiyev Maqsud Aliqulovich graduated from Karshi State University in 2003 with a degree in Mathematics and Computer Science Teaching. He holds a PhD in Pedagogical Sciences and serves as Deputy Head of the Kashkadarya Regional Preschool and School Education Department.

fields.biography_uz: Markayev Zafar Aliqulovich Qarshi davlat universiteti Jismoniy madaniyat fakultetini tamomlagan. O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Ichki ishlar organlari tizimida uzoq yillik namunali xizmat faoliyatini olib borib, Ichki ishlar vazirligi vazir o‘rinbosarining boshqaruv apparati bo‘limi boshlig‘i (podpolkovnik) lavozimida mas’uliyatli xizmat qilib kelmoqda.
fields.biography_en: Markayev Zafar Aliqulovich graduated from the Faculty of Physical Culture at Karshi State University. He serves with distinction in the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Republic of Uzbekistan as Head of Department in the Deputy Minister's Executive Office with the rank of Lieutenant Colonel.

fields.biography_uz: Qurbonov Oybek Abdusattorovich Qarshi davlat universiteti bitiruvchisi bo‘lib, iqtisodiyot va sanoat boshqaruvi yo‘nalishida yetuk mutaxassis hisoblanadi. U sanoat va kimyo sohasidagi yirik korxonalarda boshqaruv lavozimlarida, xususan «Dehqonobod kaliy zavodi» AJ boshqaruvi raisi hamda hozirda Qashqadaryo viloyati hokimligi huzuridagi «Sanoatni rivojlantirish loyiha ofisi» direktori sifatida viloyat sanoatini modernizatsiya qilishda faoliyat olib bormoqda.
fields.biography_en: Qurbonov Oybek Abdusattorovich graduated from Karshi State University with a background in Economics and Industrial Management. He has led major industrial enterprises including Dehkanabad Potash Plant JSC and currently serves as Director of the Industrial Development Project Office under the Khokimiyat of Kashkadarya Region.

Prokuratura va adliya tizimi organlarida tergovchi, bo‘lim prokurori va tuman/shahar miqyosidagi mas’ul lavozimlarda faoliyat yuritgan. Hozirda O‘zbekiston Respublikasi huquq-tartibot tizimining mas’ul rahbarlik hamda nazorat lavozimlarida samarali xizmat qilib kelmoqda.
fields.biography_en: Rajabov Alisher Hazratovich graduated in law from Karshi State University. He has served with distinction across the prosecution and justice system in investigative, prosecutorial, and regional leadership capacities.

fields.biography_uz: Ravshanov Olim Poyonovich Qarshi davlat universitetida bakalavriat (2002) va magistratura (2004) bosqichlarini tamomlagan. Filologiya fanlari bo‘yicha falsafa doktori (PhD). Universitetda 12 yil davomida ilmiy-pedagogik faoliyat yuritib, dekan muovini va dotsent lavozimlarida ishlagan. So‘ngra yoshlar ishlari, ma’naviyat-ma’rifat, mahalla va jamoat boshqaruvi tizimida qator rahbarlik lavozimlarida xizmat qilgan. Hozirda O‘zbekiston mahallalari uyushmasining Qashqadaryo viloyati boshqarmasi boshlig‘i va viloyat Kengashi deputati.
fields.biography_en: Ravshanov Olim Poyonovich earned both bachelor's (2002) and master's (2004) degrees from Karshi State University and holds a PhD in Philology. He currently heads the Kashkadarya Regional Branch of the Association of Neighborhoods of Uzbekistan and serves as a Deputy of the Regional Council of People's Deputies.

fields.biography_uz: Ashurova Sharofat Toshpo‘latovna Qarshi davlat pedagogika institutida (hozirgi Qarshi davlat universiteti) filologiya yo‘nalishida tahsil olgan. O‘zbekiston Yozuvchilar uyushmasi a’zosi, bir qator badiiy va publitsistik kitoblar muallifi. Uzoq yillardan buyon Xalqaro “Oltin meros” xayriya jamoat fondining Qashqadaryo viloyati bo‘limi boshqaruvi raisi sifatida viloyatning boy madaniy merosi, tarixiy obidalari va adabiy muhitini rivojlantirishga munosib hissa qo‘shib kelmoqda.
fields.biography_en: Ashurova Sharofat Toshpo'latovna graduated in philology from Karshi State Pedagogical Institute (now KarSU). A member of the Writers' Union of Uzbekistan and author of numerous literary and journalistic works, she serves as Chair of the Kashkadarya Regional Branch of the International 'Oltin Meros' Foundation.

fields.bio: Yirik tadbirkor va ishlab chiqaruvchi, “Alp Texno Servis” XK rahbari / asoschisi.
fields.biography_uz: Muratov Shuxrat Kaxarovich Qarshi davlat universiteti Matematika fakultetida tahsil olgan. 2005-yilda Qarshi shahrida maishiy elektronika va texnika jihozlari ishlab chiqarishga ixtisoslashgan “Alp Texno Servis” korxonasiga asos solgan. Ko‘p yillardan buyon viloyatda zamonaviy elektrotexnika ishlab chiqarishni rivojlantirib kelmoqda. 2023-yilda tadbirkorlik sohasidagi alohida yutuqlari uchun Prezident farmoni bilan davlat mukofoti bilan taqdirlangan.
fields.biography_en: Muratov Shuxrat Kaxarovich graduated in Mathematics from Karshi State University. In 2005, he founded 'Alp Texno Servis' private enterprise in Karshi, specializing in consumer electronics manufacturing. In 2023, he was honored with a State Award by Presidential Decree for outstanding entrepreneurial contributions.

QarshiDUda ilmiy-pedagogik faoliyatini boshlab, dotsent, kafedra mudiri, fakultet dekani hamda oliy ta’lim muassasalarida ilmiy ishlar va innovatsiyalar bo‘yicha prorektor vazifalarida xizmat qilgan. 2023-yildan buyon Qarshi davlat texnika universiteti (Qarshi muhandislik-iqtisodiyot instituti) rektori lavozimida samarali faoliyat yuritib kelmoqda.
fields.biography_en: Nematov Sherzod Qalandarovich graduated from the Faculty of Physics and Technology at Karshi State University in 2005. He holds a DSc degree and Professor title in Technical Sciences, and currently serves as Rector of Karshi State Technical University.

fields.biography_uz: Nusurov Usmon Nusratovich Qarshi davlat universitetida (Filologiya/Jurnalistika yo‘nalishida) tahsil olgan. Uzoq yillar davomida viloyat va respublika ommaviy axborot vositalarida muxbir, bo‘lim mudiri, mas’ul kotib, axborot xizmati rahbari hamda tahririyatlarda boshqaruv lavozimlarida faoliyat yuritgan. O‘zbekiston Jurnalistlar uyushmasi a’zosi sifatida faol publitsistik ijod bilan shug‘ullanadi.
fields.biography_en: Nusurov Usmon Nusratovich graduated in Philology and Journalism from Karshi State University. He has had a distinguished career in media, journalism, and public relations, serving as editor, department head, and press office lead across regional and national media.

O‘zbekiston teleradiojurnalistikasi va viloyat media sohasiga ulkan hissa qo‘shgan faxriy ustoz.
fields.biography_en: Xusan Temirov graduated from the Faculty of Philology at Karshi State Pedagogical Institute (now KarSU) in 1982. Since 1982, he has served with great acclaim as a TV/radio journalist, editor, and broadcast author across national and regional broadcasting networks.

fields.biography_uz: Xolmurodov Abdulhamid Erkinovich 1974-yil 2-martda Qashqadaryo viloyati Koson tumanida tug‘ilgan. 1996-yilda Qarshi davlat universitetining Amaliy matematika va informatika yo‘nalishini tamomlagan. Fizika-matematika fanlari doktori (DSc), professor. QarshiDUda o‘qituvchilikdan boshlab kafedra mudiri, fakultet dekani hamda uzoq yillar o‘quv ishlari bo‘yicha prorektor lavozimlarida faoliyat yuritgan. Hozirda universitet professori sifatida ilmiy rahbarlik va pedagogik faoliyat olib bormoqda.
fields.biography_en: Xolmurodov Abdulhamid Erkinovich was born on March 2, 1974 in Koson district, Kashkadarya. He graduated from Karshi State University in 1996 with a degree in Applied Mathematics and Computer Science. He holds a DSc degree and Professor title, having served as Dean and Vice-Rector for Academic Affairs.

fields.summary_uz: Filologiya fakultetidan boshlangan ilmiy izlanishlar va mahallalar tizimida xonadonbay ishlash orqali jamoatchilik e’tirofiga erishish yo‘li.
fields.summary_en: From philological scholarship to public governance and grassroots neighborhood development in Kashkadarya.
fields.student_takeaway_uz: Har qanday ijtimoiy boshqaruvda inson omilini birinchi o‘ringa qo‘yish va ilmiy tahlilga tayanish.
fields.student_takeaway_en: In any public governance, always prioritize human values and rely on deep analytical methods.

fields.title_uz: Shuhrat Muratov: Formulalardan yirik sanoat korxonasigacha
fields.title_en: Shuhrat Muratov: From Mathematical Formulas to Major Industrial Manufacturing
fields.summary_uz: Matematika fakultetida olingan analitik qobiliyatlarni ishlab chiqarishga yo‘naltirib, «Alp Texno Servis» XK ga asos solish tajribasi.
fields.summary_en: Transforming mathematical precision and analytical problem-solving into a leading home appliance manufacturing enterprise in Kashkadarya.
fields.student_takeaway_uz: Matematik aniqlikdagi hisob-kitob, sifatga eʼtibor va tavakkaldan qo‘rqmaslik.
fields.student_takeaway_en: Mathematical precision in calculation, uncompromising focus on quality, and courage to take calculated risks.

fields.title_uz: Sharofat Ashurova: Unutilayotgan merosni asrashga bag‘ishlangan hayot
fields.title_en: Sharofat Ashurova: A Lifetime Dedicated to Preserving Cultural Heritage
fields.summary_uz: Qashqadaryoning boy o‘tmishi, unutilayotgan madaniy obidalarini hujjatlashtirish va «Oltin meros» fondi orqali merosni asrab qolish yo‘li.
fields.summary_en: Documenting regional folklore, historical monuments, and preserving cultural legacy through the 'Oltin Meros' Foundation.
fields.student_takeaway_uz: O‘z milliy o‘zligiga, tarixi va madaniyatiga sadoqat insonni jamiyatda chinakam eʼtirofga olib keladi.
fields.student_takeaway_en: Unwavering commitment to national identity, heritage, and culture earns lasting public respect and societal recognition.

fields.title_uz: Sherzod Nematov: Talabalikdan rektorlikkacha bo‘lgan akademik yo‘l
fields.title_en: Sherzod Nematov: From University Student to Technical University Rector
fields.summary_uz: Fizika-texnika fakulteti talabaligidan boshlangan ilmiy izlanishlar, DSc ilmiy darajasi va Qarshi davlat texnika universiteti rektori lavozimiga erishish tarixi.
fields.summary_en: Academic career from physics student to PhD, DSc professor, and Rector of Karshi State Technical University.
fields.student_takeaway_uz: Oliy taʼlimda muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun sohani ich-ichidan bilish va tizimli mehnat talab etiladi.
fields.student_takeaway_en: Achieving excellence in higher education requires deep insider knowledge of the field and disciplined, systematic work.

fields.title_uz: Husan Temirov: Viloyat media maydonining ishonchli ovozi
fields.title_en: Husan Temirov: The Trusted Voice of Regional Broadcasting
fields.summary_uz: 1982-yil bitiruvchisining teleradiodagi qirq yillik fidokorona mehnati, tahliliy dasturlari va o‘ziga xos jurnalistika maktabi.
fields.summary_en: Four decades of dedicated broadcast journalism, insightful public affairs programming, and mentorship in Kashkadarya media.
fields.student_takeaway_uz: Ishga vijdonan yondashish va o‘z auditoriyasi bilan samimiy muloqot o‘rnatish.
fields.student_takeaway_en: Approach your work with unwavering integrity and cultivate genuine, heartfelt rapport with your audience.

fields.content_uz: Filologiya fakultetida tahsil olib, o‘z faoliyatini universitetda oddiy o‘qituvchilikdan boshlagan. Ilmiy izlanishlarini to‘xtatmay, filologiya fanlari bo‘yicha falsafa doktori (PhD) ilmiy darajasini himoya qilgan.
fields.content_en: After graduating from the Faculty of Philology, he began his career as an academic instructor at Karshi State University. Pursuing continuous research, he successfully defended his PhD in Philological Sciences.

fields.content_uz: Nazariy bilimlarni amaliy boshqaruvga ko‘chirib, yoshlar va maʼnaviyat sohasidagi loyihalarni muvofiqlashtirishga kirishgan.
fields.content_en: Translating academic theory into practical management, he spearheaded key youth initiatives and cultural leadership programs.

fields.content_uz: Mahalla tizimida kabinetdan chiqib, bevosita xonadonlar bilan ishlash mexanizmini joriy qilgani. Uning boshqaruvidagi tizimli yondashuv Qashqadaryo viloyati mahallalar uyushmasi boshqarmasi rahbari va viloyat Kengashi deputati darajasiga olib chiqqan.
fields.content_en: He pioneered proactive grassroots engagement in the mahalla system. His systematic approach elevated him to Head of the Kashkadarya Regional Mahalla Association and Deputy of the Regional Council.

fields.heading_en: Early Beginnings and Stepping into Business
fields.content_uz: Matematika fakultetini tamomlab, olingan analitik fikrlash qobiliyatini tadbirkorlik sohasiga yo‘naltirgan.
fields.content_en: Graduating from the Faculty of Mathematics, he channeled his rigorous analytical thinking into private enterprise and industrial engineering.

fields.content_uz: 2005-yilda tashkil etilgan kichik xizmat ko‘rsatish ustaxonasi (“Alp Texno Servis”)ni bosqichma-bosqich kengaytirib, Qashqadaryoning o‘zida murakkab elektrotexnika va maishiy texnika ishlab chiqarish liniyalarini yo‘lga qo‘ygan.
fields.content_en: Starting in 2005 from a modest technical workshop ('Alp Texno Servis'), he progressively scaled operations into state-of-the-art consumer electronics and appliance manufacturing lines in Karshi.

fields.content_uz: Viloyat bozorida importga qaramlikni kamaytirish, mahalliy ishlab chiqarish quvvatlarini yaratish va yuzlab yoshlarni ish bilan taʼminlash. Mehnatlari davlat darajasida eʼtirof etilib, nufuzli davlat mukofotiga sazovor bo‘lgan.
fields.content_en: Substantially substituting imports with locally engineered products and creating hundreds of technical jobs for youth. His contributions earned high-level state recognition and prestigious honors.

fields.content_uz: Filologik taʼlimdan so‘ng matbuot, tahririyat va o‘qituvchilik orqali xalq og‘zaki ijodi hamda viloyat tarixini o‘rganishga kirishgan.
fields.content_en: Following her philological education at the university, she embarked on extensive research into folklore and regional history through journalism, publishing, and teaching.

fields.content_uz: Qashqadaryoning boy o‘tmishi, unutilayotgan tarixiy obidalari va madaniy ziyoratgohlarini hujjatlashtirish, ularni keng ommaga yetkazishni o‘zining asosiy vazifasi deb bilgan.
fields.content_en: She made it her life's calling to document historical shrines, architectural monuments, and forgotten cultural assets across the region for future generations.

fields.content_uz: “Oltin meros” xalqaro xayriya jamoat fondining viloyat bo‘limi rahbari hamda Yozuvchilar uyushmasi aʼzosi sifatida ko‘plab moddiy-madaniy yodgorliklarni asrab qolish, restavratsiya ishlariga jamoatchilik va homiylarni jalb qilish loyihalariga boshchilik qilgan.
fields.content_en: As head of the regional branch of the 'Oltin Meros' Foundation and member of the Writers' Union, she mobilized conservation efforts, community restoration, and sponsorship for invaluable historic landmarks.

fields.content_uz: Qarshi davlat universitetining Fizika-texnika fakultetini tamomlab, shu sohada ilmiy-tadqiqot ishlarini davom ettirgan.
fields.content_en: After graduating from the Faculty of Physics and Technology at Karshi State University, he dedicated himself to advanced scientific inquiry and engineering research.

fields.content_uz: Oddiy o‘qituvchilikdan boshlab kafedra mudiri, dekan muovini, fakultet dekani hamda ilmiy ishlar bo‘yicha prorektorlik bosqichlarini bosib o‘tgan.
fields.content_en: He ascended through the academic ranks from junior instructor to department chair, vice dean, faculty dean, and vice rector for research and innovations.

fields.content_uz: Ilmiy tadqiqotlarni faqat laboratoriyada qoldirmay, sanoat va amaliyot bilan bog‘lagan (DSc fan doktori va professorlik). Natijada mintaqaning bosh texnika oliygohi — Qarshi davlat texnika universiteti rektori lavozimiga tayinlangan.
fields.content_en: He bridged laboratory research with industrial application (earning a Doctor of Technical Sciences and Full Professorship), leading to his appointment as Rector of the premier technical university in the region.

fields.heading_en: Early Years and the Path to Broadcasting
fields.content_uz: 1982-yilda Filologiya fakultetini tamomlab, o‘z davrida viloyat teleradiosi tahririyatiga yosh mutaxassis sifatida kirib kelgan.
fields.content_en: Graduating from the Faculty of Philology in 1982, he joined the regional television and radio editorial team as an enthusiastic young journalist.

fields.content_uz: Matbuot va teleradioda jonli efirlar, qishloq xo‘jaligi, ijtimoiy masalalar hamda oddiy mehnatkashlar hayotini yorituvchi tahliliy reportajlari bilan xalq mehrini qozongan.
fields.content_en: He won wide public acclaim through live broadcasts and sharp analytical reporting on agriculture, social developments, and the everyday lives of hardworking citizens.

fields.content_uz: Jurnalistik etika, xolislik va samimiyatni birlamchi o‘ringa qo‘ygan holda, bir necha o‘n yillar davomida Qashqadaryo media makonida o‘z maktabini yarata olgan.
fields.content_en: By prioritizing journalistic ethics, impartiality, and sincerity, he established a distinguished school of broadcasting in Kashkadarya over several decades.

fields.title_uz: Zamonaviy muhandislik ta’limi, ilm-fan integratsiyasi va rahbarlik mas’uliyati
fields.title_en: Modern Engineering Education, Science Integration and Leadership Responsibility
fields.intro_uz: Qarshi davlat texnika universiteti (Qarshi muhandislik-iqtisodiyot instituti) rektori, professor Sherzod Nematov bilan oliy ta’lim transformatsiyasi, muhandislik sohasidagi innovatsiyalar va yosh kadrlarni tayyorlash xususida maxsus suhbat.
fields.intro_en: A special interview with University Rector, Professor Sherzod Nematov, on higher education transformation, engineering innovations, and preparing modern professionals.
fields.pull_quote_uz: Zamonaviy rahbar faqat buyruq beruvchi emas, balki jamoasini umumiy ezgu maqsad sari ilhomlantiruvchi yetakchi bo‘lishi lozim.
fields.pull_quote_en: A modern leader is not just a director, but an inspiring force guiding their team towards a shared mission.

fields.title_uz: Zamonaviy maktab taʼlimi, pedagogik innovatsiyalar va yosh avlod tarbiyasi
fields.title_en: Modern School Education, Pedagogical Innovations, and Youth Development
fields.intro_uz: Qashqadaryo viloyati Maktabgacha va maktab taʼlimi boshqarmasi boshlig‘i o‘rinbosari, pedagogika fanlari bo‘yicha falsafa doktori (PhD) Maqsud Panjiyev bilan umumiy o‘rta taʼlim sifatini oshirish, o‘qituvchilar salohiyati va zamonaviy darsliklar xususida eksklyuziv suhbat.
fields.intro_en: An exclusive interview with Maqsud Panjiyev, Deputy Head of the Department of Preschool and School Education of Kashkadarya Region, discussing education quality, teacher skills, and innovative pedagogical approaches.
fields.pull_quote_uz: Taʼlimga kiritilgan har bir investitsiya — millatimizning ertangi taraqqiyoti va ravnaqi uchun qo‘yilgan eng mustahkam poydevordir.
fields.pull_quote_en: Every investment in education is the strongest foundation for our nation's future development and prosperity.

fields.question_uz: Universitetdagi talabalik yillaringiz va muhandislik sohasidagi dastlabki ilmiy qiziqishlaringiz qanday boshlangan?
fields.question_en: How did your student years and initial scientific interests in engineering begin?
fields.answer_uz: Qarshi davlat universiteti fizika-texnika fakultetida olgan fundamental bilimlarimiz keyingi butun ilmiy va amaliy faoliyatimizga mustahkam poydevor bo‘ldi. Ustozlarimiz laboratoriyalarda tajriba o‘tkazish, tahliliy fikrlash va muammolarga tizimli yondashishni o‘rgatishgan.
fields.answer_en: The fundamental knowledge we received at KarSU formed a solid foundation for our future scientific and practical endeavors.

fields.question_uz: Oliy ta’lim muassasasi rahbari sifatida bugungi kunda muhandislik ta’limi oldidagi asosiy vazifalarni qanday baholaysiz?
fields.question_en: As a university rector, how do you assess the primary priorities in engineering education today?
fields.answer_uz: Bugun nazariya va ishlab chiqarish amaliyoti o‘rtasida uzviy ko‘prik bo‘lishi shart. Talaba o‘qish davridanoq zamonaviy texnologik jarayonlar, avtomatlashtirish va raqamli tizimlarni to‘liq o‘zlashtirishi, bitiruvchi sifatida mehnat bozorida to‘laqonli raqobatbardosh kadrga aylanishi lozim.
fields.answer_en: Today there must be a seamless bridge between theory and industrial practice.

fields.question_uz: Qarshi davlat universitetidagi tahsil davri sizda qanday kasbiy va insoniy ko‘nikmalarni shakllantirdi?
fields.question_en: What professional and personal skills did your education at KarSU instill in you?
fields.answer_uz: Matematika fakultetidagi yillar menga chuqur mantiqiy fikrlash, har qanday murakkab vaziyatda tizimli yechim topish va o‘z ustimda to‘xtovsiz ishlash ko‘nikmasini berdi. Ustozlarimizning saboqlari va talabchanligi keyinchalik ham ilmiy tadqiqotlarimda, ham rahbarlik faoliyatimda doimiy mayoq bo‘ldi.
fields.answer_en: My years in the Faculty of Mathematics developed my deep analytical thinking, systematic problem-solving mindset, and dedication to continuous self-improvement.

fields.question_uz: Bugungi kunda maktabgacha va maktab taʼlimi tizimida qanday asosiy islohotlar amalga oshirilmoqda?
fields.question_en: What key reforms are currently being implemented in the preschool and school education system?
fields.answer_uz: Bugungi kunda asosiy eʼtiborimiz darslarning amaliy yo‘naltirilganligini oshirish, zamonaviy axborot texnologiyalarini o‘quv jarayoniga integratsiya qilish hamda pedagog kadrlarimizning metodik mahoratini doimiy oshirishga qaratilgan.
fields.answer_en: Our primary focus today is on increasing practical learning outcomes, integrating modern digital technologies into education, and consistently upgrading teachers' pedagogical expertise.

fields.content_uz: Ilm va ta’limga intilish — insonni doimo yuksak marralarga yetaklaydi. O‘z ustingizda tinimsiz ishlang va tanlagan sohangizning yetuk mutaxassisi bo‘ling.
fields.content_ru: Стремление к науке и образованию всегда ведет человека к высоким достижениям. Неустанно работайте над собой и стремитесь стать ведущим экспертом в выбранной сфере.
fields.content_en: The pursuit of knowledge and education always leads to great accomplishments. Work relentlessly on self-improvement and become a leading expert in your field.

fields.content_uz: Zamonaviy bilim, axborot texnologiyalari va kuchli intizom har qanday sohada muvaffaqiyat garovidir. Doimo yangilikka ochiq bo‘ling.
fields.content_ru: Современные знания, информационные технологии и строгая дисциплина — залог успеха в любой отрасли. Всегда будьте открыты новым возможностям.
fields.content_en: Modern knowledge, information technologies, and strong discipline are the keys to success in any domain. Always stay open to innovation.

fields.content_uz: Qat’iyat, jismoniy va ma’naviy yetuklik hamda Vatan oldidagi burchga sadoqat har bir yoshning hayotiy dasturilamali bo‘lishi lozim.
fields.content_ru: Целеустремлённость, физическая и духовная зрелость, а также верность долгу перед Родиной должны быть главным жизненным ориентиром каждого молодого человека.
fields.content_en: Determination, physical and moral integrity, and steadfast dedication to serving one's homeland should guide every young professional.

fields.content_uz: Sanoat va iqtisodiyotda aniq maqsad, tizimli tahlil va qat’iy mehnat muvaffaqiyat keltiradi. Har bir loyihaga mas’uliyat bilan yondashing.
fields.content_ru: В промышленности и экономике успех достигается четкими целями, системным анализом и упорным трудом. Подходите к каждому проекту с высокой ответственностью.
fields.content_en: In industry and economy, success is driven by clear objectives, systematic analysis, and dedicated effort. Approach every project with utmost accountability.

fields.content_uz: Qonun ustuvorligi, halollik va adolatga sadoqat — huquqshunoslikning eng oliy qadriyatlaridir. O‘z prinsiplaringizda qat’iy turing.

fields.content_en: The rule of law, integrity, and dedication to justice are the highest ideals in law. Stand firm by your core values.

fields.content_uz: Mahalla — jamiyat tayanchi. Xalqimiz bilan hamnafas yashash, har bir insonning dardu tashvishi bilan qiziqish — eng oliy mas’uliyatdir.
fields.content_ru: Махалля — основа общества. Жить в гармонии с народом и заботиться о благополучии каждого человека — наша высшая гражданская ответственность.
fields.content_en: The neighborhood (mahalla) is the pillar of society. Living in harmony with people and addressing their needs is the highest public duty.

fields.content_uz: Matematika va aniq fanlar inson tafakkurini charxlaydi. Doimiy izlanish va chuqur bilim orqali ilm-fanda yuksak natijalarga erishish mumkin.
fields.content_ru: Математика и точные науки развивают гибкость мышления. Лишь благодаря непрерывному поиску и глубоким знаниям достигаются вершины науки.
fields.content_en: Mathematics and exact sciences sharpen human intellect. Through continuous research and profound knowledge, one can reach the highest peaks of science.

fields.content_uz: Tadbirkorlikda aniq hisob-kitob, yangilikka intilish va sifat eng muhim omildir. O‘z biznesingizda qat’iyatli bo‘ling.
fields.content_ru: В предпринимательстве решающими факторами являются точный расчет, стремление к инновациям и бескомпромиссное качество. Будьте настойчивы в своем деле.
fields.content_en: In entrepreneurship, precise calculation, striving for innovation, and quality are key factors. Be persistent in your vision.

fields.content_uz: Muhandislik va zamonaviy texnologiyalar yurtimiz taraqqiyotining asosiy drayveridir. Amaliy ko‘nikma va ilmiy izlanishni uyg‘unlashtirgan mutaxassis har doim talabgir bo‘ladi.
fields.content_ru: Инженерия и современные технологии — главный двигатель прогресса. Специалист, сочетающий практические навыки с научными исследованиями, всегда будет востребован.
fields.content_en: Engineering and modern technologies are key drivers of development. Professionals who bridge hands-on skills with rigorous research will always be in high demand.

fields.content_uz: Jurnalistika — xolislik, teran mushohada va so‘z mas’uliyatini talab qiluvchi kasbdir. Doimo haqqoniy va xalq dardi bilan yozing.
fields.content_ru: Журналистика требует беспристрастности, глубокого осмысления и высокой ответственности за каждое слово. Всегда пишите правдиво и во благо общества.
fields.content_en: Journalism demands impartiality, deep reflection, and responsibility for the written word. Always remain truthful and devoted to public interest.

fields.content_uz: Efir madaniyati, samimiyat va so‘z qudratini his etish — jurnalistikaning jon tomiridir. Tinglovchi va tomoshabin mehrini qozonish uchun doimo fidoyi bo‘ling.
fields.content_ru: Культура эфира, искренность и чувство силы слова — душа журналистики. Чтобы завоевать признание аудитории, отдавайте профессии все сердце.
fields.content_en: Broadcasting culture, sincerity, and mastering the power of language are the lifeblood of journalism. Dedicated service wins the audience's lasting trust.

fields.content_uz:
Prezident

Shavkat Mirziyoyev

raisligida Nukus shahrida

Qoraqalpog‘istonni ijtimoiy-iqtisodiy rivojlantirish masalalari

ga bag‘ishlangan

yig‘ilish

bo‘lib o‘tdi.

Yigʻilishda yoshlarni zamonaviy kasblarga yoʻnaltirish, ularga mehnat bozori talablariga mos bilim va koʻnikmalar berish, texnik taʼlim sifatini oshirish boʻyicha muhim vazifalar belgilandi.

Xususan,

bir yilda 1 ming, kelgusi ikki yilda yana 5 ming yoshni axborot texnologiyalari va logistika sohasida yuqori daromadli ish bilan taʼminlash

vazifasi qoʻyildi.

Shuningdek, olis hududlardagi yoshlarga axborot texnologiyalarini oʻrgatish uchun kamida

10 nafar iqtidorli vatandoshni jalb etib

, tegishli loyihalarni amalga oshirish topshirildi.

Texnik taʼlimda xalqaro tajribani kengaytirishga ham alohida eʼtibor qaratildi.

Bugungi kunda

Nukus shahridagi 1-son texnikumda “Pearson BTEC” xalqaro dasturi

joriy etilgan boʻlib, uni tamomlagan yoshlarga 70 ta davlatda tan olinadigan kasb sertifikati beriladi.

Prezident ushbu tajribani kengaytirish vazifasini belgilab, yangi oʻquv yilidan

Amudaryo, Beruniy, Chimboy va Qoʻngʻirot tumanlaridagi bittadan texnikumda

“Pearson BTEC” xalqaro dasturini yoʻlga qoʻyishni topshirdi.

Shu bilan birga, yoshlarning amaliy koʻnikmalarini rivojlantirish maqsadida

1-oktyabrdan asbob-uskuna xaridi uchun beriladigan ssuda miqdori 20 million soʻmdan 50 million soʻmga oshiriladi. “Usta-shogird” asosida kasb oʻrganish xarajatlarini qoplashda yosh chegarasi 30 yoshdan 40 yoshga koʻtariladi.

Taxtako‘pirda Shinjon tajribasi asosida ozuqa yetishtirish tashkil etilib, xorijdan 5 ming bosh qo‘y-echki olib kelinadi.  “Kegeyli naslli parranda” korxonasi quvvatini 2-3 karra oshirib, xoldingga aylantirish,

texnikumda parrandachilik kurslari

ochish topshirildi.

Kelgusi bahordan Nukus tumanidagi 10 ming gektarda qovun yetishtirish boshlanadi. Ispaniya, AQSh, Niderlandiya va Xitoydan eng yaxshi navlar va mutaxassislar jalb etilib, qayta ishlash hamda eksport bilan shug‘ullanadigan xolding tashkil qilinadi.

Tumandagi texnikum laboratoriya va sinov poligoni bilan ta’minlanib, qovunchilik bo‘yicha tajriba almashish metodik markazi

ga aylantiriladi.

Nukus tibbiyot ilmiy akademiyasi, Bolalar klinikasi, Onkologiya markazi va yangi ko‘p tarmoqli shifoxona birlashtirilib,

Universitet tibbiy klasteri

tashkil qilinadi.

Kelasi yili qoraqalpoq xalqining buyuk farzandi, shoir va mutafakkir

Berdaq Qarg‘abay o‘g‘li tavalludining 200 yilligini munosib nishonlash

taklifi bildirildi.  Shoirning ilmiy-ijodiy merosini o‘rganish, raqamlashtirish, asrab-avaylash va yoshlarga yetkazishni qamrab olgan dasturni bir oyda ishlab chiqish topshirildi.

Belgilangan vazifalar Qoraqalpogʻiston yoshlariga zamonaviy kasblarni egallash, xalqaro standartlar asosida taʼlim olish va mehnat bozorida talab yuqori boʻlgan sohalarda oʻz oʻrnini topishi uchun yangi imkoniyatlarni kengaytiradi.

“

Buyuk istiqlolimizning uch ming yillik ildizlari

insho tanlovining fakultet bosqichi

o‘tkazildi.

Tanlovni fakultetning yoshlar masalalari bo‘yicha dekan o‘rinbosari

Farrux Muqimov

ochib berib, mazkur tanlovning yoshlarning

tarixiy bilimlarini boyitish, milliy qadriyatlar va ajdodlar merosiga bo‘lgan hurmatini oshirish

Shuningdek, ishtirokchilarga tanlovda faol qatnashish, o‘z fikrlarini mustaqil va ijodiy yondashuv asosida bayon etishlari uchun muvaffaqiyat tiladi.

Tanlov davomida talabalar mavzu yuzasidan o‘zlarining

bilim va dunyoqarashi, tarixiy tafakkuri hamda ijodiy qobiliyatlarini

namoyon etdilar.

Pedagogika, sport va san’at fakulteti

bitiruvchi talabalari uchun tashkil etilgan seminarda “Kelajak markazi”, O‘zMilliybank AJ Qarshi filiali

“Kelajakka qadam”

dasturi mas’ullari hamda ish beruvchi tashkilotlar vakillari ishtirok etdi.

Unda yoshlarning

bandligi, kasbiy ko‘nikmalarini rivojlantirish va tadbirkorlikka yo‘naltirish

masalalari muhokama qilindi. Shuningdek,

“Kelajak tadbirkori–2026”

dasturi doirasidagi moliyaviy imkoniyatlar, kredit mahsulotlari va tadbirkorlikni boshlash bo‘yicha amaliy tavsiyalar berildi.

Seminar yakunida talabalar o‘zlarini qiziqtirgan savollariga mutaxassislardan javob oldilar.
